 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA backend
+// ============================================================================
+
+// The CPU octree uses owning pointers, which are not suitable for a device
+// traversal.  This compact representation preserves the same hierarchy and
+// triangle lists while making every node reachable by a single integer index.
+struct DeviceOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    uint32_t firstTriangle;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+void flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source,
+                       std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                       std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    nodes.emplace_back();
+
+    DeviceOctreeNode& destination = nodes[nodeIndex];
+    destination.center = source.center;
+    destination.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    destination.firstTriangle = 0;
+    destination.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) destination.children[i] = -1;
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        destination.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+        destination.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (source.children[i]) {
+            const size_t childIndex = nodes.size();
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[i] = static_cast<int>(childIndex);
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[i], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+template <typename T>
+T* cudaAllocate(size_t count) {
+    T* result = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&result), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return result;
+}
+
+__device__ uint64_t roomsimMix64(uint64_t value) {
+    value ^= value >> 30;
+    value *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value ^= value >> 27;
+    value *= 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRandom01(uint64_t key) {
+    // Use 24 random bits, the precision used by a float uniform variate.
+    return static_cast<val_t>(roomsimMix64(key) >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 roomsimRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t key) {
+    val_t u = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x243f6a8885a308d3ULL);
+    val_t v = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x13198a2e03707344ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const Vec3 ab = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 ac = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    return triangle.a + ab * u + ac * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,
+                                             const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1,
+                                             const Vec3& v2) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
+    const Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
+    const Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                  const Triangle* triangles,
+                                  const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                  const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                  uint32_t sourceTriangle,
+                                  uint32_t destinationTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(direction.squaredNorm());
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    // The construction stops once nodes are smaller than 0.5 units, so the
+    // octree depth is bounded well below this stack size for the generated
+    // room.  An explicit stack avoids device recursion and keeps traversal
+    // local to each form-factor sample.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!roomsimRayIntersectsBox(from, to, node)) continue;
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < node.triangleCount; ++offset) {
+                const uint32_t triangleIndex = octreeTriangles[node.firstTriangle + offset];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+
+                const Triangle& triangle = triangles[triangleIndex];
+                const val_t distance = roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0) {
+                    stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                         val_t* kij,
+                                         uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    val_t formFactor = ZERO;
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const uint64_t sampleKey = pair * NUM_RAYS + static_cast<uint64_t>(ray);
+        const Vec3 pointI = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleI, sampleKey * 4ULL);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleJ, sampleKey * 4ULL + 2ULL);
+
+        if (roomsimRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, octreeTriangles, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = 1.0f / sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosPhiI = fmaxf(ZERO, direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosPhiJ = fmaxf(ZERO, (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        formFactor += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    kij[pair] = formFactor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Vec3 centerI = (triangles[i].a + triangles[i].b + triangles[i].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 centerJ = (triangles[j].a + triangles[j].b + triangles[j].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 difference = centerI - centerJ;
+    const val_t distance = sqrtf(difference.squaredNorm());
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+
+__global__ void propagateRadiosityKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                         const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho,
+                                         val_t* radB, uint32_t numTriangles,
+                                         uint32_t timestep, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                         uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partialSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(triangle) * numTriangles;
+
+    for (uint32_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < numTriangles; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == triangle) continue;
+
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = static_cast<size_t>(timestep - delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (triangle == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep) * numTriangles + triangle] =
+            rho[triangle] * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                                       uint32_t numTriangles, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                       uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ int bestTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    val_t localBest = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+    for (uint32_t delay = threadIdx.x; delay < numTimesteps; delay += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t time = delay; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            const val_t source = radB[(static_cast<size_t>(time - delay) * numTriangles) + sourceIndex];
+            const val_t response = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + triangle];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        if (correlation > localBest) {
+            localBest = correlation;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(delay);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestValues[threadIdx.x] = localBest;
+    bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t candidateValue = bestValues[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int candidateTime = bestTimes[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidateValue > bestValues[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidateValue == bestValues[threadIdx.x] && candidateTime < bestTimes[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestValues[threadIdx.x] = candidateValue;
+                bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = candidateTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimes[0]);
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda() {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "RoomSim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    printf("CUDA device: %s (%.0f MB)\n", properties.name,
+           static_cast<double>(properties.totalGlobalMem) / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
+}
+
+void checkCudaKernel() {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+}
+

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA backend
+// ============================================================================
+
+// The CPU octree uses owning pointers, which are not suitable for a device
+// traversal.  This compact representation preserves the same hierarchy and
+// triangle lists while making every node reachable by a single integer index.
+struct DeviceOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    uint32_t firstTriangle;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+void flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source,
+                       std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                       std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    nodes.emplace_back();
+
+    DeviceOctreeNode& destination = nodes[nodeIndex];
+    destination.center = source.center;
+    destination.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    destination.firstTriangle = 0;
+    destination.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) destination.children[i] = -1;
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        destination.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+        destination.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (source.children[i]) {
+            const size_t childIndex = nodes.size();
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[i] = static_cast<int>(childIndex);
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[i], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+template <typename T>
+T* cudaAllocate(size_t count) {
+    T* result = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&result), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return result;
+}
+
+__device__ uint64_t roomsimMix64(uint64_t value) {
+    value ^= value >> 30;
+    value *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value ^= value >> 27;
+    value *= 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRandom01(uint64_t key) {
+    // Use 24 random bits, the precision used by a float uniform variate.
+    return static_cast<val_t>(roomsimMix64(key) >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 roomsimRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t key) {
+    val_t u = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x243f6a8885a308d3ULL);
+    val_t v = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x13198a2e03707344ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const Vec3 ab = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 ac = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    return triangle.a + ab * u + ac * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,
+                                             const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1,
+                                             const Vec3& v2) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
+    const Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
+    const Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                  const Triangle* triangles,
+                                  const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                  const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                  uint32_t sourceTriangle,
+                                  uint32_t destinationTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(direction.squaredNorm());
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    // The construction stops once nodes are smaller than 0.5 units, so the
+    // octree depth is bounded well below this stack size for the generated
+    // room.  An explicit stack avoids device recursion and keeps traversal
+    // local to each form-factor sample.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!roomsimRayIntersectsBox(from, to, node)) continue;
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < node.triangleCount; ++offset) {
+                const uint32_t triangleIndex = octreeTriangles[node.firstTriangle + offset];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+
+                const Triangle& triangle = triangles[triangleIndex];
+                const val_t distance = roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0) {
+                    stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                         val_t* kij,
+                                         uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    val_t formFactor = ZERO;
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const uint64_t sampleKey = pair * NUM_RAYS + static_cast<uint64_t>(ray);
+        const Vec3 pointI = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleI, sampleKey * 4ULL);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleJ, sampleKey * 4ULL + 2ULL);
+
+        if (roomsimRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, octreeTriangles, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = 1.0f / sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosPhiI = fmaxf(ZERO, direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosPhiJ = fmaxf(ZERO, (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        formFactor += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    kij[pair] = formFactor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Vec3 centerI = (triangles[i].a + triangles[i].b + triangles[i].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 centerJ = (triangles[j].a + triangles[j].b + triangles[j].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 difference = centerI - centerJ;
+    const val_t distance = sqrtf(difference.squaredNorm());
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+
+__global__ void propagateRadiosityKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                         const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho,
+                                         val_t* radB, uint32_t numTriangles,
+                                         uint32_t timestep, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                         uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partialSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(triangle) * numTriangles;
+
+    for (uint32_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < numTriangles; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == triangle) continue;
+
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = static_cast<size_t>(timestep - delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (triangle == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep) * numTriangles + triangle] =
+            rho[triangle] * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                                       uint32_t numTriangles, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                       uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ int bestTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    val_t localBest = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+    for (uint32_t delay = threadIdx.x; delay < numTimesteps; delay += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t time = delay; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            const val_t source = radB[(static_cast<size_t>(time - delay) * numTriangles) + sourceIndex];
+            const val_t response = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + triangle];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        if (correlation > localBest) {
+            localBest = correlation;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(delay);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestValues[threadIdx.x] = localBest;
+    bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t candidateValue = bestValues[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int candidateTime = bestTimes[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidateValue > bestValues[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidateValue == bestValues[threadIdx.x] && candidateTime < bestTimes[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestValues[threadIdx.x] = candidateValue;
+                bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = candidateTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimes[0]);
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda() {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "RoomSim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    printf("CUDA device: %s (%.0f MB)\n", properties.name,
+           static_cast<double>(properties.totalGlobalMem) / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
+}
+
+void checkCudaKernel() {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+}

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA backend
+// ============================================================================
+
+// The CPU octree uses owning pointers, which are not suitable for a device
+// traversal.  This compact representation preserves the same hierarchy and
+// triangle lists while making every node reachable by a single integer index.
+struct DeviceOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    uint32_t firstTriangle;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+void flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source,
+                       std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                       std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    nodes.emplace_back();
+
+    DeviceOctreeNode& destination = nodes[nodeIndex];
+    destination.center = source.center;
+    destination.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    destination.firstTriangle = 0;
+    destination.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) destination.children[i] = -1;
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        destination.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+        destination.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (source.children[i]) {
+            const size_t childIndex = nodes.size();
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[i] = static_cast<int>(childIndex);
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[i], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+template <typename T>
+T* cudaAllocate(size_t count) {
+    T* result = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&result), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return result;
+}
+
+__device__ uint64_t roomsimMix64(uint64_t value) {
+    value ^= value >> 30;
+    value *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value ^= value >> 27;
+    value *= 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRandom01(uint64_t key) {
+    // Use 24 random bits, the precision used by a float uniform variate.
+    return static_cast<val_t>(roomsimMix64(key) >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 roomsimRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t key) {
+    val_t u = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x243f6a8885a308d3ULL);
+    val_t v = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x13198a2e03707344ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const Vec3 ab = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 ac = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    return triangle.a + ab * u + ac * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,
+                                             const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1,
+                                             const Vec3& v2) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
+    const Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
+    const Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                  const Triangle* triangles,
+                                  const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                  const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                  uint32_t sourceTriangle,
+                                  uint32_t destinationTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(direction.squaredNorm());
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    // The construction stops once nodes are smaller than 0.5 units, so the
+    // octree depth is bounded well below this stack size for the generated
+    // room.  An explicit stack avoids device recursion and keeps traversal
+    // local to each form-factor sample.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!roomsimRayIntersectsBox(from, to, node)) continue;
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < node.triangleCount; ++offset) {
+                const uint32_t triangleIndex = octreeTriangles[node.firstTriangle + offset];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+
+                const Triangle& triangle = triangles[triangleIndex];
+                const val_t distance = roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0) {
+                    stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                         val_t* kij,
+                                         uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    val_t formFactor = ZERO;
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const uint64_t sampleKey = pair * NUM_RAYS + static_cast<uint64_t>(ray);
+        const Vec3 pointI = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleI, sampleKey * 4ULL);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleJ, sampleKey * 4ULL + 2ULL);
+
+        if (roomsimRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, octreeTriangles, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = 1.0f / sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosPhiI = fmaxf(ZERO, direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosPhiJ = fmaxf(ZERO, (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        formFactor += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    kij[pair] = formFactor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Vec3 centerI = (triangles[i].a + triangles[i].b + triangles[i].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 centerJ = (triangles[j].a + triangles[j].b + triangles[j].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 difference = centerI - centerJ;
+    const val_t distance = sqrtf(difference.squaredNorm());
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+
+__global__ void propagateRadiosityKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                         const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho,
+                                         val_t* radB, uint32_t numTriangles,
+                                         uint32_t timestep, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                         uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partialSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(triangle) * numTriangles;
+
+    for (uint32_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < numTriangles; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == triangle) continue;
+
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = static_cast<size_t>(timestep - delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (triangle == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep) * numTriangles + triangle] =
+            rho[triangle] * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                                       uint32_t numTriangles, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                       uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ int bestTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    val_t localBest = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+    for (uint32_t delay = threadIdx.x; delay < numTimesteps; delay += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t time = delay; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            const val_t source = radB[(static_cast<size_t>(time - delay) * numTriangles) + sourceIndex];
+            const val_t response = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + triangle];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        if (correlation > localBest) {
+            localBest = correlation;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(delay);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestValues[threadIdx.x] = localBest;
+    bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t candidateValue = bestValues[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int candidateTime = bestTimes[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidateValue > bestValues[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidateValue == bestValues[threadIdx.x] && candidateTime < bestTimes[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestValues[threadIdx.x] = candidateValue;
+                bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = candidateTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimes[0]);
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda() {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "RoomSim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA backend
+// ============================================================================
+
+// The CPU octree uses owning pointers, which are not suitable for a device
+// traversal.  This compact representation preserves the same hierarchy and
+// triangle lists while making every node reachable by a single integer index.
+struct DeviceOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    uint32_t firstTriangle;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+void flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source,
+                       std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                       std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    nodes.emplace_back();
+
+    DeviceOctreeNode& destination = nodes[nodeIndex];
+    destination.center = source.center;
+    destination.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    destination.firstTriangle = 0;
+    destination.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) destination.children[i] = -1;
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        destination.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+        destination.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (source.children[i]) {
+            const size_t childIndex = nodes.size();
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[i] = static_cast<int>(childIndex);
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[i], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+template <typename T>
+T* cudaAllocate(size_t count) {
+    T* result = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&result), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return result;
+}
+
+__device__ uint64_t roomsimMix64(uint64_t value) {
+    value ^= value >> 30;
+    value *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value ^= value >> 27;
+    value *= 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRandom01(uint64_t key) {
+    // Use 24 random bits, the precision used by a float uniform variate.
+    return static_cast<val_t>(roomsimMix64(key) >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 roomsimRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t key) {
+    val_t u = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x243f6a8885a308d3ULL);
+    val_t v = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x13198a2e03707344ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const Vec3 ab = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 ac = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    return triangle.a + ab * u + ac * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,
+                                             const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1,
+                                             const Vec3& v2) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
+    const Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
+    const Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F;
+
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                  const Triangle* triangles,
+                                  const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                  const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                  uint32_t sourceTriangle,
+                                  uint32_t destinationTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(direction.squaredNorm());
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    // The construction stops once nodes are smaller than 0.5 units, so the
+    // octree depth is bounded well below this stack size for the generated
+    // room.  An explicit stack avoids device recursion and keeps traversal
+    // local to each form-factor sample.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!roomsimRayIntersectsBox(from, to, node)) continue;
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < node.triangleCount; ++offset) {
+                const uint32_t triangleIndex = octreeTriangles[node.firstTriangle + offset];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+
+                const Triangle& triangle = triangles[triangleIndex];
+                const val_t distance = roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0) {
+                    stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                         val_t* kij,
+                                         uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    val_t formFactor = ZERO;
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const uint64_t sampleKey = pair * NUM_RAYS + static_cast<uint64_t>(ray);
+        const Vec3 pointI = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleI, sampleKey * 4ULL);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleJ, sampleKey * 4ULL + 2ULL);
+
+        if (roomsimRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, octreeTriangles, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = 1.0f / sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosPhiI = fmaxf(ZERO, direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosPhiJ = fmaxf(ZERO, (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        formFactor += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    kij[pair] = formFactor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Vec3 centerI = (triangles[i].a + triangles[i].b + triangles[i].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 centerJ = (triangles[j].a + triangles[j].b + triangles[j].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 difference = centerI - centerJ;
+    const val_t distance = sqrtf(difference.squaredNorm());
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+
+__global__ void propagateRadiosityKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                         const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho,
+                                         val_t* radB, uint32_t numTriangles,
+                                         uint32_t timestep, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                         uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partialSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(triangle) * numTriangles;
+
+    for (uint32_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < numTriangles; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == triangle) continue;
+
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = static_cast<size_t>(timestep - delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (triangle == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep) * numTriangles + triangle] =
+            rho[triangle] * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                                       uint32_t numTriangles, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                       uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ int bestTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    val_t localBest = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+    for (uint32_t delay = threadIdx.x; delay < numTimesteps; delay += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t time = delay; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            const val_t source = radB[(static_cast<size_t>(time - delay) * numTriangles) + sourceIndex];
+            const val_t response = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + triangle];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        if (correlation > localBest) {
+            localBest = correlation;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(delay);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestValues[threadIdx.x] = localBest;
+    bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t candidateValue = bestValues[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int candidateTime = bestTimes[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidateValue > bestValues[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidateValue == bestValues[threadIdx.x] && candidateTime < bestTimes[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestValues[threadIdx.x] = candidateValue;
+                bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = candidateTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimes[0]);
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda() {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "RoomSim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    printf("CUDA device: %s (%.0f MB)\n", properties.name,
+           static_cast<double>(properties.totalGlobalMem) / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
+}
+
+void checkCudaKernel() {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+}
+

 // Initialization
 // ============================================================================

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA backend
+// ============================================================================
+
+// The CPU octree uses owning pointers, which are not suitable for a device
+// traversal.  This compact representation preserves the same hierarchy and
+// triangle lists while making every node reachable by a single integer index.
+struct DeviceOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    uint32_t firstTriangle;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+void flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source,
+                       std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                       std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    nodes.emplace_back();
+
+    DeviceOctreeNode& destination = nodes[nodeIndex];
+    destination.center = source.center;
+    destination.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    destination.firstTriangle = 0;
+    destination.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) destination.children[i] = -1;
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        destination.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+        destination.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (source.children[i]) {
+            const size_t childIndex = nodes.size();
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[i] = static_cast<int>(childIndex);
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[i], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+template <typename T>
+T* cudaAllocate(size_t count) {
+    T* result = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&result), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return result;
+}

+__device__ uint64_t roomsimMix64(uint64_t value) {
+    value ^= value >> 30;
+    value *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value ^= value >> 27;
+    value *= 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRandom01(uint64_t key) {
+    // Use 24 random bits, the precision used by a float uniform variate.
+    return static_cast<val_t>(roomsimMix64(key) >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 roomsimRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint64_t key) {
+    val_t u = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x243f6a8885a308d3ULL);
+    val_t v = roomsimRandom01(key * 2ULL + 0x13198a2e03707344ULL);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const Vec3 ab = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 ac = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    return triangle.a + ab * u + ac * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,
+                                             const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1,
+                                             const Vec3& v2) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
+    const Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
+    const Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool roomsimRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                  const Triangle* triangles,
+                                  const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                  const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                  uint32_t sourceTriangle,
+                                  uint32_t destinationTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 direction = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(direction.squaredNorm());
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 directionNormalized = direction / rayLength;
+
+    // The construction stops once nodes are smaller than 0.5 units, so the
+    // octree depth is bounded well below this stack size for the generated
+    // room.  An explicit stack avoids device recursion and keeps traversal
+    // local to each form-factor sample.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+
+    while (stackSize > 0) {
+        const int nodeIndex = stack[--stackSize];
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!roomsimRayIntersectsBox(from, to, node)) continue;
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < node.triangleCount; ++offset) {
+                const uint32_t triangleIndex = octreeTriangles[node.firstTriangle + offset];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) continue;
+
+                const Triangle& triangle = triangles[triangleIndex];
+                const val_t distance = roomsimRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormalized, triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0) {
+                    stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* octreeTriangles,
+                                         val_t* kij,
+                                         uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    val_t formFactor = ZERO;
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const uint64_t sampleKey = pair * NUM_RAYS + static_cast<uint64_t>(ray);
+        const Vec3 pointI = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleI, sampleKey * 4ULL);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = roomsimRandomPoint(triangleJ, sampleKey * 4ULL + 2ULL);
+
+        if (roomsimRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, octreeTriangles, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = 1.0f / sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosPhiI = fmaxf(ZERO, direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosPhiJ = fmaxf(ZERO, (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        formFactor += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    kij[pair] = formFactor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        uint32_t numTriangles) {
+    const uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles) * numTriangles;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / numTriangles);
+    const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Vec3 centerI = (triangles[i].a + triangles[i].b + triangles[i].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 centerJ = (triangles[j].a + triangles[j].b + triangles[j].c) / 3.0f;
+    const Vec3 difference = centerI - centerJ;
+    const val_t distance = sqrtf(difference.squaredNorm());
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+
+__global__ void propagateRadiosityKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                         const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho,
+                                         val_t* radB, uint32_t numTriangles,
+                                         uint32_t timestep, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                         uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t partialSums[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(triangle) * numTriangles;
+
+    for (uint32_t emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < numTriangles; emitter += blockDim.x) {
+        if (emitter == triangle) continue;
+
+        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[row + emitter];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const size_t sourceTime = static_cast<size_t>(timestep - delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity = radB[sourceTime * numTriangles + emitter];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[emitter], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    partialSums[threadIdx.x] = sumB;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partialSums[threadIdx.x] += partialSums[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        const val_t emission = (triangle == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+        radB[static_cast<size_t>(timestep) * numTriangles + triangle] =
+            rho[triangle] * partialSums[0] + emission;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radB, val_t* distances,
+                                       uint32_t numTriangles, uint32_t numTimesteps,
+                                       uint32_t sourceIndex) {
+    const uint32_t triangle = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= numTriangles) return;
+
+    __shared__ val_t bestValues[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+    __shared__ int bestTimes[CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE];
+
+    val_t localBest = ZERO;
+    int localBestTime = 0;
+    for (uint32_t delay = threadIdx.x; delay < numTimesteps; delay += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t time = delay; time < numTimesteps; ++time) {
+            const val_t source = radB[(static_cast<size_t>(time - delay) * numTriangles) + sourceIndex];
+            const val_t response = radB[static_cast<size_t>(time) * numTriangles + triangle];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        if (correlation > localBest) {
+            localBest = correlation;
+            localBestTime = static_cast<int>(delay);
+        }
+    }
+
+    bestValues[threadIdx.x] = localBest;
+    bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = localBestTime;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride != 0; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            const val_t candidateValue = bestValues[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            const int candidateTime = bestTimes[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidateValue > bestValues[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidateValue == bestValues[threadIdx.x] && candidateTime < bestTimes[threadIdx.x])) {
+                bestValues[threadIdx.x] = candidateValue;
+                bestTimes[threadIdx.x] = candidateTime;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        distances[triangle] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimes[0]);
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda() {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "RoomSim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    printf("CUDA device: %s (%.0f MB)\n", properties.name,
+           static_cast<double>(properties.totalGlobalMem) / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
+}
+
+void checkCudaKernel() {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+}

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA backend

+// The CPU octree uses owning pointers, which are not suitable for a device
+// traversal.  This compact representation preserves the same hierarchy and
+// triangle lists while making every node reachable by a single integer index.
+struct DeviceOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    uint32_t firstTriangle;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+void flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source,
+                       std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                       std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const size_t nodeIndex = nodes.size();
+    nodes.emplace_back();
+
+    DeviceOctreeNode& destination = nodes[nodeIndex];
+    destination.center = source.center;
+    destination.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    destination.firstTriangle = 0;
+    destination.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) destination.children[i] = -1;
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        destination.firstTriangle = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+        destination.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+
+    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
+        if (source.children[i]) {
+            const size_t childIndex = nodes.size();
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[i] = static_cast<int>(childIndex);
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[i], nodes, triangleIndices);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+template <typename T>
+T* cudaAllocate(size_t count) {
+    T* result = nullptr;
+    if (count != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&result), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    return result;
+}
